crossRefs.note: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this…
He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath…

translations.web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
translations.bsb: Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
translations.kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
translations.asv: And he went out from thence; and he cometh into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
